Pushed to Gerrit for review: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1816 (commit fc4c90dcac).

Implemented the reconcile-pass project-visibility preflight:
- access_check.py: reusable single source of truth (also for ticket 9702) — check_mapped_project_visibility(repo_root, *, probe=None, client_cls=AcliClient, env=None, query_project=None, projects_store_mod=None) -> ProjectVisibilityResult(status, required, visible, missing, detail); status in ok/missing/transport_unavailable/skipped. enforce_mapped_project_visibility(**kwargs) is the raising wrapper (ProjectVisibilityError on missing, TransportUnavailableError fail-closed). Probes GET /rest/api/3/project/search via AcliClient._direct_rest_get (built-in retry, no hand-rolled loop); pagination fails closed on page-cap exhaustion.
- _preflight.py: reconcile-pass gating (mutating passes only; configured Cloud backend only; observable skip otherwise), maps verdict -> PreflightAbort.
- __main__.run_pass_result: calls the preflight strictly before reconcile_once (only outbound-mutation call). Missing/invisible key or unreachable backend aborts with an actionable message naming offending key(s); no Jira write. Never crashes the pass.

RED->GREEN: 16 new tests in tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_preflight_project_visibility.py with an injected fake probe (no live Jira). Teeth proven via mutation: (1) forcing status='ok' -> 3 tests fail; (2) disabling the wiring abort -> 2 wiring tests fail. Gates: make lint PASS, make typecheck PASS, complexity baseline new=0 increased=0 stale=0, __main__.py 778 LOC (<800), cc77 transport-typing guard PASS. Rebased onto origin/main 11d5994594.

Leaving ticket open pending Verified +1 / LLM-Review +1.
